channel.title: BK Reader (The Brooklyn Reader) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from BK Reader (The Brooklyn Reader) (bkreader.com)

item.title: Brooklyn Democratic Party Pulls Support For Hochul Over Running Mate Pick
item.description: Several hours after Governor Kathy Hochul picked former City Council Speaker Adrienne Adams as her running mate, the Brooklyn Democratic Party rescinded its endorsement of the governor.

item.title: NYC Mayor Endorses Kathy Hochul For Governor
item.description: In an op-ed in The Nation, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said he supports the governor's commitment to work through tough issues despite their differences.

item.title: Duo Wanted for Punching, Robbing Man Outside Bed-Stuy McDonald's
item.description: Authorities say the men approached the 28-year-old in front of 1531 Fulton St. just before 9:45pm on Jan. 24.

item.title: 11-Year-Old Girl Killed by School Bus in Bath Beach Hit-And-Run
item.description: Emergency personnel responded to a 911 call for a pedestrian struck at 23rd Avenue and Bath Avenue just after 3:00pm. Authorities say the bus struck an unidentified female and did not remain on scene.

item.title: Feb 6: Brooklyn Black History Maker, Michael K. Williams
item.description: During his time on screen, Williams became one of the country’s most prominent actors and was described as a "singular presence, onscreen and off, who made every role his own.”

item.title: A Night of Love, R&B And Soul at Brooklyn Conservatory of Music
item.description: Uton Onyejekwe, Tahira Clayton and more lead an evening of Black love songs spanning generations during a special Feb. 12 event at the Brooklyn Conservatory of Music.

item.title: NYC Calls on Vendors, Artists to be Part of Summers Streets And Earth Day
item.description: Programming partners can submit applications by Feb. 11 for art installations, March 6 for Car-Free Earth Day and June 26 for Summer Streets.

item.title: Brooklyn Borough President Funds 5 Mobility Vans For Midwood Org
item.description: HASC Center in Midwood purchased five wheelchair-accessible vans with $564,000 in FY26 capital funding allocated by Brooklyn Borough President Antonio Reynoso. They will be used to transport Brooklynites with developmental disabilities to medical appointments and recreational activities.

item.title: Brooklyn Filmmaker Raises a Drink to a Historic Brooklyn Dive Bar
item.description: In his namesake documentary, Brooklyn filmmaker Leon Chase captures the colorful staff and rotating cast of oddball patrons during the final months of Hank’s Saloon, a beloved dive bar in Boerum Hill.
